svg.title: Recovery proves one inclusion; exactness needs both
svg.desc: First obtain a target feasible point, recover source variables, and check source equations, constraints and matched observations. This gives target-observation inclusion. Exact observed-set equality also requires coverage of every source observation.
svg.text: Recovery proves one inclusion; exactness needs both
S and T are feasible sets; h and ĥ map them into the same joint observation space.
If this succeeds for EVERY target feasible point:
A conservative target may still exclude valid source observations.
Also show coverage of EVERY source feasible observation:
Together, the two inclusions give ĥ(T) = h(S).
Checking one returned solution establishes only that point’s recovery obligations.
Without a retained recovery relation or other evidence, source constraints may remain unassessed.
Decision equivalence also requires the declared decision and objective mappings.
